document.abstract: For the past 20 years, technology for digital editing, processing and storage of film, video tape and digital file originated content has continued to advance until today it is the norm. However, many problems still affect digital post-production including required storage size and performance, access speed, storage and network bandwidth, copying and transport of many large files, tracking metadata, and managing files and versions. By optimizing the digital infrastructure and storage fabric network design, incorporating lossless compression, and leveraging media-specific SOA workflow driven processes and services, most tasks can be orchestrated and significant portions of workflows can be automated, resulting in lower costs and higher quality.
